description: GetMint shows you how AI models talk about your brand. Ask about a domain or topic you track and get your visibility score against competitors, a share-of-voice leaderboard, how models describe your brand, and the exact sources they cite. Then act on it in the same conversation: research a content brief, edit the outline, and generate the article. Requires a GetMint account.

defaultPrompt: How visible is nike.com in AI answers this month, and which competitors are beating us?
Show sentiment for my brand across ChatGPT, Gemini and Perplexity, plus the sources they cite.
Create a content brief for "best running shoes for flat feet" on nike.com and write the article.
